summary: Iteration 8 — full verification of (a) the rebuilt clients carousel and (b) the Studio visual editor. BACKEND: 26/26 pytest pass (16 new studio/admin tests + 10 existing contact tests). Verified GET /api/ , GET /api/content (data+updated_at, 25 clients, blocks/styles/theme keys present), POST /api/admin/login (200 correct / 401 wrong), GET /api/admin/session (401 without token, {ok:true} with), PUT /api/admin/content (400 on empty), GET /api/admin/content?stage=draft|published (400 on bogus stage), dirty flag TRUE after a draft change and FALSE immediately after POST /api/admin/discard (merged-tree comparison fix CONFIRMED), public /api/content did NOT show the draft change, publish round-trip (hero.badge -> TEST_QA_PUBLISH -> visible publicly -> original tree republished -> dirty=false, published tree byte-identical to the original), GET /api/admin/overview (clients=25, dirty=false, audit list, no _id), GET /api/admin/revisions (no _id), GET /api/admin/contacts, POST /api/admin/media (tiny PNG) -> GET /api/media/{id} 200 image -> listed -> DELETE 200 -> GET 404 -> 2nd DELETE 404, POST /api/admin/media with a non-image -> 400, POST /api/contact 200. FRONTEND public site: 3 marquee-rows, 75 client cards rendered at 1920 AND at 390 (track width 5.9k-6.6k px vs 1920/390 viewport => never a gap; right-edge gap is always negative, i.e. cards always overflow past the row), all 3 rows move continuously (55/47/63 px per 1.5s, row 1 in reverse) at 1920 and at 390, ALL 75 have loading='eager' and 0 broken images, hover on row 1 stops it (delta 0.04px/1s) while rows 0 and 2 keep moving, resumes after mouseleave (32px/1s). Hero/stats counters (100M+, 25+, 1,200+, 4)/services/process/contact/footer render, EL<->EN switcher works, contact form POST /api/contact succeeded with the Greek success toast + inline confirmation. Zero console errors on the public site. STUDIO: login with SocialGrowth2026! -> studio-root; click-to-edit inside the iframe verified for hero.titleA ('Τίτλος — 1η γραμμή'), hero.primary ('Κύριο κουμπί'), services.items.0.title ('Τίτλος υπηρεσίας'), clients.items.0 ('Κάρτα: Crats' + Κρύψιμο/Αντίγραφο/Διαγραφή) and stats.items.0 ('Αριθμός') — every click selected the correct element/label; text typed in the inspector updated the preview within ~1s and the top bar went 'Μη δημοσιευμένες αλλαγές'. DRAG: dragging hero.badge ~60px right / 25px down produced exactly X=60 / Y=25 in the sliders and the element stayed offset; setting the X slider to 120 moved the preview element exactly +60px. STYLE INSPECTOR: enabling Μέγεθος γραμμάτων on hero.sub and setting 32 -> computed 32px; device tab 'Κινητό' set to 13 kept desktop at 32 (verified both sliders and computed styles), studio-device-mobile preview computed 13px, 'Καθάρισε στυλ' restored 18px. SECTIONS/BLOCKS: 6 built-in layout-row-* listed, up/down reorder changed the preview order (hero,results,clients,...) and back, eye icon removed/restored the section from the preview, add-section offers all 12 block types, added video+faq+pricing -> all 3 appear in the list and render in the preview (block-video-*, block-faq-*, block-pricing-*) with real content, editing the video block's Μικρός τίτλος updated the preview live, duplicate created block-faq-b0eml6khgd and delete removed it. TEMPLATES: template-minimal-light adds class 'sg-light', body bg rgb(246,246,248) with text rgb(20,20,28) (readable, verified by screenshot + luminance), template-undo restores the dark look, neon-night and mono-brutal restyle with white h1 on near-black bg, no console errors; Προσαρμοσμένα στυλ (N) list tracks manual styles and 'Καθάρισε όλα' clears them (needs the window.confirm accepted). Επιλογή/Περιήγηση modes behave correctly (no inspector in browse mode). CLEANUP: POST /api/admin/discard executed at the end — draft==published, blocks=0, styles=0, hero.badge original, save state 'Όλα δημοσιευμένα', published tree unchanged (25 clients, 0 blocks, 0 styles).

issues: Client logos whose artwork is white/very light (il Desto, Papastavrou Shops, Kiboko outline, Efthimiou wordmark) become almost invisible on the light cards. The light-mode ink remap flips text but not logo images — consider a subtle card tint/border or an invert filter for logos flagged as 'light artwork'.

A freshly added video block with zero videos renders a very tall (~400px) empty section on the site (only the editor shows the 'Κανένα video' hint). Suggest rendering a neutral placeholder or auto-collapsing the block when it has no items, so an owner cannot publish a blank gap.
The copyright line sits flush against the right edge of the container (no right padding breathing room compared to the left column).
The up/down reorder icon buttons have no title/aria-label (the settings/duplicate/delete/eye ones do) and no data-testid, so they are only reachable positionally — minor a11y + testability gap.

action_items: Optional: handle light-artwork client logos in sg-light mode (invert/tint) so they stay visible in the Minimal Light / Editorial templates.
Optional: render a placeholder (or collapse) for content-less blocks (video/gallery/logos) so an empty block cannot publish a blank gap.
Optional: add title/aria-label + data-testid to the layout row up/down arrows.
critical_code_review_comments: Marquee pauses via IntersectionObserver(rootMargin 300px) and document.hidden — correct for perf, but note that any automated check of 'is it moving' must first scroll the clients section into view, otherwise the transform legitimately stays at 0.

admin.py is 529 lines and mixes auth, content, media processing and inbox; process_image() (PIL) runs synchronously inside the async upload handler and will block the event loop on large images — consider run_in_threadpool.

admin_content()/overview() now compare merged trees for `dirty` — verified correct; but both endpoints issue 4 Mongo round-trips per call (published, draft, and two raw find_one). Could be reduced to 2.
clear-all-styles / delete rely on window.confirm — fine for humans, but blocks headless automation unless a dialog handler accepts (documented for the next agent).
seed_data_creation: 1 TEST_QA_Studio contact via API + 1 TEST_QA_Iter8 contact via the public form; 1 TEST_QA media PNG (created then deleted). Draft mutations (hero badge/title text, hero.badge + hero.sub styles, 3 added blocks) were all reverted with POST /api/admin/discard. The publish round-trip added 2 auto-backup revisions to site_revisions but the published tree is byte-identical to the original.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gotchas learned this round: (1) marquee rows only animate when the clients section is in view (IntersectionObserver) — scroll first, then diff the inline transform of row.firstElementChild; (2) inside the Studio the preview is an iframe (data-testid='studio-preview'); use page.frame_locator and click with force=True on [data-sg=...]; (3) inspector inputs have NO type attribute — select with input:not([type=range]):not([type=checkbox]):not([type=color]); (4) NEVER force-click a container div in the inspector (e.g. div:has-text('Τυπογραφία')) — it lands on the 'Κρύψιμο το στοιχείο' switch and hides the element; click the group's <button> instead; (5) to enable an 'Αυτόματο' style field, match b.closest('div').innerText.split('\n')[0] === 'ΜΈΓΕΘΟΣ ΓΡΑΜΜΆΤΩΝ', then the newly appeared range is identified by its min:max (font size = 8:140, max width = 80:1400, scale = 40:200, X/Y = -400:400, rotation = -45:45); (6) data-testid='style-reset' only exists when the selected element has styles; (7) page.on('dialog', accept) is required for clear-all-styles and block delete; (8) block rows are data-testid='layout-row-block:<id>' and their icon buttons carry title Ρυθμίσεις/Αντίγραφο/Διαγραφή/Κρύψιμο (use .first — nested item rows share the titles); (9) always finish with POST /api/admin/discard (token is a 3-part JWT in localStorage).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect reproduced. Two intermediate 'failures' during this run were test-harness artifacts, not product bugs: 'Καθάρισε όλα' appearing to do nothing (Playwright auto-dismisses the window.confirm) and the hero badge disappearing (my force-click on a container div toggled the per-element Hide switch). Both were re-verified as correct behaviour once the script targeted the right element / accepted the dialog.
